head: November Pixel Drop: Pixel Solver, Create My Widget and Gemini Call Screen
dek: Google's November Pixel Drop started rolling out on 10 November to supported Pixel phones, tablets and watches. It adds an AI math solver to the Calculator, a widget builder you describe in words and Gemini Call Screen.
details: Pixel Solver (Pixel 11 only) solves everyday math from prompts; a Unit Conversion mode with live exchange rates comes to the Pixel 6a and newer. Create My Widget reaches the Pixel 10 and 11. Gemini Call Screen screens calls for you on the Pixel 11 in the US, in English. Transit Mode can now switch on by itself, and Pixel VIPs shows contacts' shared location and battery from Find Hub. Pixel 10 owners get Rambler voice typing and Gemini task automations. Google's Pixel Tag tracker is now on sale. Pixel Watch 3 and newer get step-by-step workouts.
where: Pixel phones, tablets and watches, rolling out; features vary by model and country
means: Your Pixel gets new features over the next days, and Pixel 10 owners get several that launched with the Pixel 11.
todo: Check for the update in Settings > System > Software updates.
